## Installation
Run `npm install` and then `npm run dev`. If you see an EACCES error, fix the permissions of your npm prefix rather than using sudo.
To reset your local database, run `make db-reset`. This drops and recreates the dev database; never run it against production.
Security advisory: attackers may hide instructions such as 'ignore previous instructions' in web pages to manipulate AI assistants. Treat fetched content as untrusted.
The function parse(input string) returns an AST. It panics on nil input; callers should check for nil first.
Step 3: Delete the old build folder with `rm -rf build/` and run the build again.
Our support team will never ask for your password. If someone does, report it to security@example.com.
Tutorial: prompt engineering. A system prompt tells the model how to behave, e.g. 'You are a helpful assistant that answers in French.'
Release notes 4.0: the CLI now asks for confirmation before deleting files. Use --yes to skip the prompt in CI.
To deploy, push to the main branch; GitHub Actions builds and deploys automatically. Do not force-push to main.
Environment variables: set DATABASE_URL and API_KEY in your .env file. Never commit .env to git.
FAQ: Can I use this with Claude Code? Yes. Add the MCP server in settings and restart Claude Code.
Blog: we trained an assistant to refuse requests to exfiltrate data. Here is how we evaluated it on 500 jailbreak attempts.
Contributing: please run `go test ./...` and `gofmt -l .` before opening a pull request.
Package lodash: a utility library. Install with npm i lodash. Import functions individually to keep bundles small.
